body: 5 tips for Kokani youth heading to the Gulf.
One or two pages. Your skills, your experience, your contact details. Update it before every application.
Check the company and the role before you accept. Be careful with anyone who asks you for money to get a job.
Good English opens doors. A few Arabic words make every workplace friendlier. A new skill or certificate keeps you ahead.
Talk to Kokanis who are already there. Ask questions. Most will happily help.
